side.notes: The adult references agree on an exaggerated rounded hump, small eye below the hump, terminal fleshy lips, robust deep cichlid trunk, long-based median fins, strong peduncle, and broad rounded tail.

top.uncertainty: High. No calibrated orthographic dorsal photograph was found. The broad cichlid width is inferred from adult oblique images and the government description of a robust, stout body.
top.notes: Maximum width and hump breadth are intentionally provisional and require downstream top-view review.

front.uncertainty: High. No calibrated orthographic frontal photograph was found. Lip projection, eye seating, cheek volume, and hump symmetry are inferred from lateral-oblique originals.
front.notes: The front view cannot be accepted as measured until a verified frontal original is added.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: continuous exaggerated nuchal hump above eye and skull
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Seven close stations form a broad rounded fatty forehead dome continuous with the skull and dorsal trunk. Two near-level crest stations remove the single pointed apex exposed by the initial fable-v4 render.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: smoothly oval robust cichlid trunk and strong peduncle
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Revision 4 adds a posterior-flank transition and rounds the dorsal and ventral station envelope so the stout breeder trunk reads as an oval cichlid, not a near-rectangular slab, before tapering into a substantial peduncle.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: terminal fleshy mouth, long median fins, and broad rounded tail
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Three compact face stations taper the forehead into a small terminal seat. Short thick paired lip folds remain inside that support instead of projecting as rods, while long dorsal and anal bases taper into a nearly unforked rounded caudal envelope.

proportions.name: representative adult total length
proportions.notes: The unchanged 0.237 m axial station span plus 0.0615 m caudal envelope keeps the nominal body-and-tail silhouette at 0.2985 m. Compact terminal lip geometry brings the estimated rendered rest extent to approximately 0.30308 m, inside the 0.30 m adult target tolerance.

proportions.name: maximum trunk height divided by total length
proportions.uncertainty: Moderate. The deep robust form is strongly supported, but no calibrated morphometric of the selected red-pearl strain was found.
proportions.notes: The maximum ordinary trunk depth is approximately 0.127 m, producing a stout oval cichlid profile without allowing the fatty hump to turn the entire fish into a rectangular block.

proportions.name: maximum body width divided by maximum trunk height
proportions.uncertainty: High. This is a conservative interpretation of robust, stout body language and oblique images, not a published orthographic measurement.
proportions.notes: The source remains thicker than an angelfish or discus while reducing the over-wide frontal read of fable-v3 and preserving the lateral compression of a large Central American cichlid.

proportions.name: nuchal-hump rise above ordinary dorsal trunk
proportions.uncertainty: Moderate. The hump is diagnostic and biologically supported, but magnitude varies strongly by sex, strain, age, condition, and husbandry.
proportions.notes: The broad crest rises about 30 mm beyond the opercular top contour. The root, posterior, paired crest, anterior, front, brow, and head stations produce a continuous rounded kok instead of the initial fable-v4 pointed cone.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: red-orange adult ground with paler posterior and belly
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: A warm red head and shoulder transition through orange-red flank tones rather than forming a single flat red material.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: turquoise-white pearling over body and median fins
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Seeded cellular spots create small brilliant scale-associated pearls with irregular spacing and brightness, without copying any source pixels.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: broken dark lateral flower line
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: A narrow mid-lateral field of irregular dark characters is broken into multiple marks rather than rendered as a continuous stripe.

previousCandidates.notes: Independent three-view review rejected the narrow pointed horn, abrupt forehead-to-snout transition, detached gray rod-like lips, angular fan-like caudal, uniform pearls, and circular lateral marks.
Independent review found the revised pearling and flower markings acceptable but rejected the remaining pointed crest, abrupt face, puckered ring mouth, and pointed caudal corners.

User review rejected the candidate as subpar. Its body read as a near-rectangular slab, the oversized frontal hump became a wall rather than a rounded fatty dome, the eye and face lacked correct adult-male hierarchy, and the paint remained pale and sparse compared with the red, densely pearled reference phenotype.

reviewedCandidate.notes: The revised fable-v4 candidate passed its technical gates at 0.30811 m and corrected the pointed kok and tiny eye. Comparison with the exact user target still rejected its terminal face because the paired lips rendered as two thin projecting rods and the forehead-to-mouth transition remained wall-like.

proposedCandidate.notes: The 0.4.2 candidate passed its revised technical gates at 0.30811 m, but visual comparison with the exact user target rejected the terminal face: both lip arcs projected as thin rods and the forehead-to-mouth transition remained wall-like. Patch 0.4.3 preserves the accepted kok, eye, trunk, fins, paint, scale, rig, and clips while tapering only the last three face stations and replacing the wide projecting arcs with compact thick lip folds. Rebuild and perceptual review remain required.

mismatches.note: Independent three-view review still rejected a pointed crest and abrupt face. Revision 3 lowers the crest, keeps adjacent dome stations within 4 mm of its top, broadens the full dome, and steps the brow, head, and snout down continuously. The lip arcs are reduced to small seated terminal folds rather than a puckered ring.

Independent review still rejected pointed caudal corners. Revision 3 increases distal-edge sampling from 15 to 31 columns, seats the root across more of the peduncle, and rebalances span with corner shortening so the unforked outline resolves as a continuous broad curve.
Independent review found the revised pearling and lateral flower markings acceptable. Revision 3 deliberately preserves the Flowerhorn paint backend unchanged.

The fable-v3 station envelope stayed too deep and wide across most of its length, then held the hump nearly level into the brow, producing a slab body and wall-like forehead. Revision 4 adds a posterior-flank transition, rounds both trunk edges, reduces width, peaks the hump at one broad crest, and steps continuously down through the anterior dome, brow, head, snout, and lip base.

The fable-v3 eye was too large and low while the lips read as a small pale ring. Revision 4 seats a smaller eye higher below the dome, shortens the terminal head, and reshapes the paired lip arcs into visibly fleshy forward folds.
Revision 4 replaces the blocky median-fin height plateaus with longer smooth tapers and broadens the densely sampled caudal while increasing its rounded edge cut.

Revision 4 deepens the red ground, increases turquoise-white pearl density and contrast on body and median fins, strengthens irregular black flower characters, and increases distal fin translucency without copying reference pixels.

The first fable-v4 author preview and side view exposed a tall pointed cone created by one narrow crest maximum. Source patch 0.4.1 replaces that apex with a seven-station root-to-brow envelope and two near-level crest stations, lowering maximum rise while widening the entire rounded kok.

mismatches.area: rejected initial fable-v4 eye and mouth
mismatches.note: The first fable-v4 render retained a tiny dark bead eye and two nearly invisible mouth bars. Source patch 0.4.1 increases eye radius and height while preserving surface seating, exposes more iris around the pupil, nearly doubles lip thickness, broadens both arcs, projects their centers, and changes the cue from near-black to dark fleshy red.

The visually improved 0.4.1 source measured 0.30961 m along x against a 0.30900 m upper bound. Patch 0.4.2 shortens only the caudal length from 0.0630 m to 0.0615 m, predicting a 0.30811 m rest length while preserving the accepted kok and facial cues.

The technically passing 0.4.2 author preview still rendered the paired lips as two thin projecting rods, and the nearly linear terminal face read as a wall rather than a short cichlid snout. Patch 0.4.3 reduces lip span and forward offset, increases their radius relative to span, and tapers only the snout, lip-base, and snout-tip stations so the mouth is compact, fleshy, and physically seated. This remains a pending render-dependent check.
Body thickness, hump breadth, and frontal lip volume remain high-uncertainty inferences because no verified orthographic top or frontal source is available.
Source and candidate validation passed, but full swim, idle, and display motion were not independently accepted for perceptual naturalism.
